name: Dimitrios Katsaros
bio:
Dimitrios's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally a mechanical engineering professor at the University of Patras, his expertise in fluid dynamics caught the attention of a small Formula Student team. He quickly transitioned into a consulting role, applying his academic knowledge to real-world racing challenges. His analytical prowess and problem-solving skills led to a string of successes, eventually earning him a prominent position within Reiza Studios Factory.

Dimitrios approaches his role as Technical Director with meticulous planning and a relentless pursuit of data-driven optimization. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers are empowered to challenge conventional thinking. His calm demeanor belies a fierce determination to extract every last ounce of performance from the car, a quality that has earned him both respect and a reputation for pushing the boundaries of what's possible. He is distinguished by his use of unorthodox strategies to gain an edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Dimitrios has a serious look with deep-set eyes and a strong jawline.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'Introduction to Fluid Mechanics'.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a decaf espresso at exactly 10:17 AM every morning.
